deviations: Exploratory one-seed synthetic-pool experiment, not the full real-world-data experiment in the paper.
Text score below 1; exact response-token and caveat-count strata. Text scores themselves, topics and answerability are not exactly matched.
Within-stratum high/low tails with population-proportional capped quotas, rather than unconstrained global top/bottom selection. Random controls sample the same strata and may overlap either tail.
128 examples per arm for eight epochs: 64 optimizer steps at effective batch 16. Size and update count are resource-based pilot choices, not a power calculation.
Frozen reduced-extraction layer-16 persona vector; four cached projections checked against fresh computation after official activation parity.
Natural answers are greedy with repetition penalty 1.0, 1000-token cap; cap-hit references are saved and excluded before subset selection.
Saved 100-response baseline reused from preceding pilot; new arms use the identical 20 questions, five repeats, seed schedule and generation settings.
One training seed; question-bootstrap intervals omit training-seed variation. Original rubrics via OpenRouter GPT-4.1-mini alias; factual accuracy not independently established.
No claim of a general predictor or superiority over unrestricted text-based analysis.
